meta.subject_note: 국가 간 대립 소재가 아니라 국내 개인 재테크다. 태극기 구체는 '한국의 평균적 은퇴자' 한 사람을 대신하는 캐릭터이며 상대편 국가 구체를 세우지 않는다. 두 번째 구체가 등장할 때도 같은 태극기 구체(은퇴 부부)로 두어 국가 간 승부·외교 서사로 읽히지 않게 했다. 등장 대상은 연금 명세서·병원비·장바구니·저금통·계좌다.
meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above; every other surface that would carry writing — registers, ledgers, rosters, signs, labels, documents — shows printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail. Do not render any english text, latin letters, fake chinese characters, gibberish lettering or invented words anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '평생 부었는데 종이 한 장에 적힌 숫자가 700,427이다' — 노령연금 전체 평균 월 70만 427원(2026.1)을 거대한 명세서 한 장으로 세우고 은퇴자 구체를 그 앞에 작게 두어 크기 대비만으로 무력감을 전달한다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth polished floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a single enormous official pension statement sheet stands upright and slightly tilted in the centre of the frame, towering over everything, the Korean Hangul words "연금 명세서" printed large and crisp across the top of the sheet as its header, the entry rows below printed too small and slightly out of focus to read except one huge clean printed figure reading "700,427" alone across the middle of the sheet. In front of it and far smaller, reaching only a third of the sheet's height, stands a glossy countryball sphere whose entire surface is wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — a white field with a red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre and four black trigrams — with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn on that white field, wearing a beige cardigan and a flat cap over its small body with black gloved hands. It stands at mid height looking straight up at the figure, eyes stretched enormous with shrunken pupils, mouth hanging open, three sweat beads flying off the top of the sphere, tiny trembling lines around its shoulders, both little hands frozen halfway raised. Behind them the background is a softly blurred bank branch interior — glass partitions, a long counter, ceiling fluorescent strips — reduced to shapes only. A cool grey-white key light rakes across the giant sheet so the white paper is the brightest mass in the picture.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '병실 한 자리를 지키는 값이 벽처럼 쌓인다' — 요양병원 6인실 한 달 최소 140만원(병원비 70+간병비 60+기저귓값 10)과 65세 이상 1인당 연평균 진료비 551만원(전체 평균의 2.4배)이라는 구멍 ③ 지출 파트의 근거를 영수증 벽으로 물리화했다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain pale hospital floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a towering wall of hospital billing slips fills the right two thirds of the frame at mid height and above, hundreds of thin sheets stacked and fanned into a leaning cliff, every slip printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, a few loose sheets tumbling through the air with motion trails. A glossy countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with large cartoon eyes and mouth on the white field, wearing a thin nylon jacket and a visitor tag, stands at the left at mid height, small against the wall of paper, both gloved hands pushing uselessly against the base of the leaning stack. Its expression: eyes squeezed into strained arcs with pinprick pupils, mouth pulled wide open in a grimace, one big sweat drop bursting off the sphere, shaking motion lines on both arms. Behind it a blurred long-term care ward — a row of iron bed frames, an IV stand, a folded wheelchair — is reduced to soft shapes under cold white light. Cold clinical key light from above, desaturated blue-grey palette with the paper the only bright value.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '통장 숫자는 그대로인데 살 수 있는 건 줄었다' — 세후 예금이자 연 2.6% 대 물가 2.8~3.2%, 1억을 넣어도 한 달 21만 7,000원이라는 구멍 ② 수치를 텅 빈 장바구니와 동전 두 개로 옮겼다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth market floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a single glossy countryball sphere fills most of the upper part of the frame, wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with huge expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn on the white field, wearing a quilted vest and a knitted scarf, its small body with black gloved hands. It holds a worn leather wallet upside down at mid height and shakes it; exactly two coins tumble out and hang in the air just below the wallet with short motion trails, and nothing else falls. Hooked over its other arm at mid height is a thin market basket, completely empty except for one bundle of scallions. Its expression: eyelids drooped to half-mast over flat dull eyes, mouth pulled down into a long wobbling curve, one small blue vertical shade line down the side of the sphere, a tiny puff of dust from the empty wallet. Behind it a blurred traditional market stall loaded with produce and a bright price board reduced to soft shapes and colour blocks — the stall is overflowing while the basket is empty. Warm bulb light on the stall against a cooler grey light on the sphere.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '구멍은 다섯인데 이미 두 곳에서 새고 있다' — 확정 제목 '구멍 5개 중 2개'를 저금통에 뚫린 다섯 구멍과 그중 두 곳에서 쏟아지는 동전이라는 형태 하나로 물리화했다. 글자를 다 지워도 제목이 읽히는 컷.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain even floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a giant ceramic piggy bank stands at mid height in the centre-right of the frame, rendered with crisp glossy detail, and five clean round holes are punched in a row across its side. Two of those five holes are gushing coins in bright arcs that fly sideways and upward with sparkle trails, while the other three holes sit dark and quiet — the count of five and the two that are open must be instantly readable. A glossy countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with large cartoon eyes and mouth on the white field, wearing a cardigan and reading glasses, stands at the left at mid height and lunges with both small gloved hands spread, trying to cover the two gushing holes at once and failing, one hand slipping off. Its expression: eyes wide with pinprick pupils darting to the second leaking hole, eyebrows slammed together, mouth stretched into a wide panicked open shape, sweat beads flying, speed lines behind both arms. Background: a softly blurred apartment living room reduced to warm shapes. Warm key light from the left, gold coins the brightest accent.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '다섯을 세려고 손을 폈는데 두 개에서 멈췄다' — 제목이 요구하는 자가진단('내 쪽에 몇 개가 뚫렸나')을 손가락 두 개라는 단일 기호로 전달한다. 클릭 후 세어 보게 만드는 동기가 여기서 생긴다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth pale floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: one glossy countryball sphere dominates the upper five-eighths of the frame in a tight emotion close-up, wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with enormous expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn on the white field, wearing a plain grey knit collar and a flat cap. It raises one small black gloved hand beside itself at eye height with exactly two fingers extended straight up and the rest curled down, the counting visibly stopped dead at two, while its other hand hovers as if it had meant to keep going. Its expression: eyes bulging with whites showing all around tiny pupils, pupils rolled up and to the side as if searching its own memory, mouth open in a small stunned oval, one thick sweat drop hanging at the top of the sphere, short trembling lines radiating from the raised hand. Behind it, far out of focus, five dark round holes float in a row across a plain wall — two of them ringed with a faint warning glow, three still dark. Cool even key light, restrained palette so the taeguk red and blue and the two raised fingers are the only strong shapes.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '같은 명세서를 사이에 둔 두 사람의 온도가 다르다' — 은퇴 부부(둘 다 태극기 구체)가 한 장의 명세서를 마주 든 구도. 국가 간 대결이 아니라 한 가구 안의 장면이며, 노후 적정생활비 부부 월 298만 1,000원과 실제 조달 가능액의 간극이 근거다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain kitchen floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: two glossy countryball spheres face each other across the frame at mid height, both wrapped edge to edge in the same South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with large cartoon eyes and mouths drawn on the white field; this is one retired couple at home, not two nations. The left sphere wears a flat cap and a cardigan, the right sphere wears a knitted scarf and round reading glasses. Between them, held up at mid height by one gloved hand from each side, is a single official statement sheet turned toward the camera, carrying the Korean Hangul words "연금 명세서" printed large and crisp across its top and the entry rows below printed too small and slightly out of focus to read except one clean printed figure reading "700,427" alone in the middle. Their expressions are deliberately opposite: the left sphere has eyes blown wide with pinprick pupils, mouth wrenched open, sweat beads and shock lines bursting outward; the right sphere has eyes narrowed to tired half-moons, mouth flattened into a resigned line, one small hand pressed to the side of its own sphere, a single blue shade line falling down its face. Behind them a blurred apartment kitchen — table, hanging cupboard, window — reduced to soft warm shapes. Warm ceiling light from above, the white sheet the brightest mass between them.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — smooth bank floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: one glossy countryball sphere is centred and fills the upper five-eighths of the frame from side to side in a straight frontal close-up, the camera exactly level with its eyes. Its entire surface is wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with huge expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn on the white field. It wears a worn dark jacket with a shiny collar and a scuffed old wristwatch on its small gloved hand. Directly behind it, filling the whole background in soft focus, is a Korean bank branch interior in neutral grey-white light: ceiling fluorescent strips, an aluminium-framed glass partition, a teller counter running across mid height, wall boards and pinned paper notices too far away and out of focus to read, and a queue-ticket dispenser with a torn paper strip hanging from it. At the far left edge of the frame, at mid height, only the top corner of a freshly issued white statement sheet shows between two gloved fingers. Its expression: eyes aimed sharply downward and slightly off camera as if it has just lowered them from the sheet, upper lids heavy, pupils shrunk to small dots, mouth pressed into one hard straight line, a single bead of sweat sliding down the side of the sphere, two short vertical shade lines above the eyes, everything held perfectly still with no motion effects.

Scene: one glossy countryball sphere is centred and fills the upper five-eighths of the frame from side to side in a straight frontal close-up, the camera exactly level with its eyes. Its entire surface is wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field, red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre, four black trigrams — with huge expressive cartoon eyes and mouth on the white field. It wears a windbreaker with a faded club emblem over a knitted vest, and one small gloved hand crushes a hiking cap it has just pulled off, held at mid height. Behind it a Korean bank waiting area fills the background in soft focus under neutral grey-white fluorescent light: a glass partition, a long teller counter across mid height, a wall board and pinned notices too far away and out of focus to read, a row of steel chairs and a water cooler. At the right edge of the frame, raised just above shoulder height beside the sphere so it never covers the face, its other gloved hand holds one statement sheet turned toward the camera: the sheet is carrying the Korean Hangul words "연금 명세서" printed large and crisp across its top and the entry rows below printed too small and slightly out of focus to read except one large clean printed figure reading "700,427" alone in the middle, and the paper is the brightest mass in the picture. Its expression: eyes squeezed down into narrow suspicious slits re-reading the figure, brows drawn hard together into a deep V, mouth opened just a crack as if a word died halfway out, one thin tear line welling at the corner of one eye without falling, the gripping hand crumpling the edge of the sheet.
